sentences.en: Someone asked Juha a hard question.

sentences.ar: ليش الدنيا نصها ليل ونصها نهار؟
sentences.en: Why is the world half night and half day?

sentences.ar: جحا فكر شوي وقال: ما بعرف.
sentences.en: Juha thought a little and said: I do not know.

sentences.ar: الرجل زعل: إنت عالم ولازم تعرف!
sentences.en: The man was upset: you are a scholar and you should know!

sentences.ar: قال جحا: العالم بيعرف إمتى يقول ما بعرف.
sentences.en: Juha said: a scholar knows when to say I do not know.
